failure_summary.description: Answers were overexpanded relative to the concise requested form, adding a category noun or a clue-supplied qualifier.
Agents chose an associated title, place, process, or relationship instead of the specific referent or answer slot requested.

patch.reasoning: The existing skill already instructs agents to give the shortest answer at the requested granularity, avoid repeating supplied categories, and distinguish the requested entity from related details or mechanisms. These failures reflect noncompliance with those rules rather than a clear skill gap, so adding another version would be duplicative.
